source: TSE Acuerdos 1659-2023 (first round) and 1361-2023 (runoff); department-grain TREP aggregates for non-presidential races (out of scope for this loader).
notes: Per ADR-012 + Operational Commitments: the 2023 Memoria Electoral has not been published as of 2026-05; this loader holds the line until it is. When the Memoria publishes, a separate re-ingest path overwrites these rows and flips elections.is_provisional FALSE. The per-candidate vote counts below are reconstructed from TSE press releases and the cited Acuerdos; the 'Otros (resto del campo)' bucket absorbs the residual of minor candidates so the per-candidate sum matches the published national total exactly. If a maintainer obtains the original Acuerdo PDFs and finds drift, update the numbers below — the round-trip test asserts sum(votes) == declared_total_valid_votes per round.
